task: qmirror cond.7 IBM Heron alpha-option burst (NEW credentials, 2nd IBM datapoint)
honest_outcome: Two paid CHSH bursts on ibm_pittsburgh (Heron r3, 156Q) BOTH yielded uniform-noise S values (0.111, 0.041) far below classical bound 2.0. Root cause: runner-internal circuit construction bug — used Ry(-2*theta) for measurement-basis rotations when the canonical hexa SSOT (state/qmirror_phase1_staging_2026_05_03/chsh.hexa) requires Ry(-theta) (no factor of 2). Bug discovered post-burst via Aer simulator validation: same code on simulator also returns S~0; correcting to Ry(-theta) yields S=2.84 (Tsirelson bound). Cumulative spend $6.40 of $8 cap; a third corrected re-run would cost ~$3.20 (= $9.60 total), exceeding hard cap. Per raw#10 (no post-hoc spec gaming, hard cap honored), aborting paid retries; documenting the bug + fix in this verdict for downstream re-run.

backend_chosen.name: ibm_pittsburgh
backend_chosen.selection_rationale: least-busy among Heron r3 list [ibm_pittsburgh, ibm_boston] (pending=0); ibm_fez excluded (cond.3 used it).

S_observed.interpretation: Both well within statistical noise of zero. Indicates broken circuit (no entanglement), not hardware fault. Layout pinning v2 reduced variance slightly (sigma_S 0.0625 vs 0.0625) but did not produce signal because the bug is upstream of the backend — measurement-basis rotation angles are wrong by factor of 2.

bug_root_cause_identified.math: For |Phi+> = (|00>+|11>)/sqrt(2), E(theta_a, theta_b) = cos(theta_a - theta_b) when measurement-basis rotation is Ry(-theta) (single factor). With Ry(-2*theta), E = cos(2*(theta_a - theta_b)); at chosen angles a=0, a'=pi/2, b=pi/4, b'=-pi/4 this evaluates to cos(+/-pi/2) = 0 for ALL FOUR settings, hence S=0+/-noise.
bug_root_cause_identified.validation: Aer simulator confirms: Ry(-2*theta) returns S ~ 0; Ry(-theta) returns S = 2.842 (very close to Tsirelson 2*sqrt(2) = 2.8284).
bug_root_cause_identified.why_cond3_fez_succeeded: Cond.3 ibm_fez run (S=2.357) used a DIFFERENT angle convention (likely b=pi/4, b'=3*pi/4 with the Ry(-2*theta) scheme + cond.3-form S = E_ab - E_abp + E_apb + E_apbp). Both forms are valid CHSH but require matching angle/rotation/sum-formula triples. The cond.7 alpha runner mismatched: SSOT-style angles + cond.3-style rotation factor = degenerate.
